summary.text: Wanda Paige, listed by Ballotpedia as Wanda Brownlee Paige, is a Democratic state representative who has represented Kansas House District 35 since 2024 and is seeking election on November 3, 2026. She has also served on the Kansas City Public Schools board since 2018.

paragraphs.text: Paige was appointed to the Kansas House by the Wyandotte County Democrats in September 2024, replacing Representative Marvin Robinson II, who died in August 2024; Ballotpedia lists her as taking office on October 4, 2024.
She has been an at-large member of the Kansas City Public Schools board since January 8, 2018.
During the 2025-2026 session Paige served on the Agriculture, Child Welfare and Foster Care, House Local Government, and Welfare Reform committees.
